Confirming I attached the HSM attestation PDF and the hardware chain reference. Notes:
- Attestation file: hsm-attestation-aws-hsm-20270401.pdf (contains vendor attestation, HSM serial prefix, and an auditor signature block)
- We are using an AWS CloudHSM cluster in primary and secondary regions; KEK is wrapped per-tenant by our key-wrapping service which references the HSM-backed KEK. Replica KEKs are derived with the same lineage but distinct wrapped blobs per-region.
